title: Battle of Mokra (1445)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Mokra (1445)", at revision 1382552481, opens: "The First Battle of Mokra took place on October 10, 1445, near mountain Mokra. It was an Ottoman retaliation to a message sent by Skanderbeg to Murad II. The Albanian forces under Skanderbeg defeated the Ottoman forces under Firuz Pasha. It was the second major Albanian victory over the Ottoman Empire." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3300868, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1445 battle of the Albanian–Ottoman Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
